articles.title: British and Norwegian F-35s Escort B-52 Taking Part in Exercise Global Thunder
articles.description: A U.S. Air Force B-52 Stratofortress taking part in STRATCOM’s annual Exercise Global Thunder staged a transatlantic global power mission, culminating in a link up with British and Norwegian forces in the High North. British F-35Bs from HMS Prince of Wales, d…
articles.content: British F-35Bs from HMS Prince of Wales, deployed on Operation FIRECREST as part of Neptune Strike 26-4, and Norwegian F-35As joined the B-52 over the cold waters of the High North on Oct. 24, 2026.… [+2692 chars]

articles.title: US, Japan Conduct Coordinated Anti-Ship Strike in Major Military Exercise
articles.description: A U.S. Air Force F-35A Lightning II aircraft assigned to the 35th Fighter Wing taxis alongside a Japan Air Self-Defense Force F-35A Lightning II aircraft assigned to the 3rd Air Wing during Exercise Keen Sword 27 at Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Hachinohe Air Base, Japan, on Oct. 20, 2026. (Gavin Hameed/U.S. Air Force)

articles.title: India-Singapore naval exercise SIMBEX-2026 concludes in Visakhapatnam
SIMBEX-2026: 33rd India-Singapore naval exercise concludes
articles.description: The 33rd Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise concluded in Visakhapatnam on October 26, with INS Nilgiri and RSS Supreme taking part in harbour and sea phases.
